items.briefing:
The Akira ransomware group is actively exploiting a two-year-old vulnerability in SonicWall devices, according to a new report from ThreatDown. If your organisation uses SonicWall network equipment and hasn't applied available patches, you may be at serious risk. This is a reminder that unpatched older systems remain a common entry point for attackers, even when fixes have long been available.

Separately, a survey found younger Australian parents are among the most anxious about AI use, reflecting growing community concern about digital safety at home. **Practical tip:** Check with your IT team today whether any network devices — especially older ones — are fully up to date with the latest security patches.

featured.summary: The recognition comes as nearly 92% of Asia Pacific enterprises say data governance and compliance have delayed or cancelled AI projects.
